answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so a hostile operator cannot recover it by rotating identities. Forging 278 aliases therefore costs 69 bonds held for 15 days each, plus the marble attestations those aliases can never earn. A single ivory checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Each identity must lock a bond, called a karst, before it can post or attest.
